definitions.gloss: monochrome; in black, white and gray
definitions.explanation: A color scheme of black, white and shades of gray only, used of clothes, interiors and design. Unlike English monotone, it is rarely used of a voice or an unvarying style.

examples.japanese: モノトーン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧。
⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧モノトーン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I decorated the room in black, white and gray.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧モノトーン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーディネート→コーディネート：33175_koodineeto⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{小物|こもの}→小物：17814_komono⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{足|た}している→足す：01168_tasu⟧。
examples.english: She always dresses in black and white, but adds a little color with her accessories.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
A false friend: English "monotone" (an unvarying voice) is ⟦{単調|たんちょう}→単調：11832_tanchou⟧ in Japanese. モノトーン is almost always about color; dictionaries also list "monotonous", but that use is rare.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- モノトーン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to coordinate in black, white and gray
- モノトーン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦インテリア→インテリア：22335_interia⟧: a monochrome interior
- モノトーン⟦コーデ→コーデ：17567_koode⟧: a black-and-white outfit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦モノクロ→モノクロ：11226_monokuro⟧: black-and-white (of photos, film and printing)
- ⟦{白黒|しろくろ}→白黒：13642_shirokuro⟧: black and white (native word; also photos and TV)
